churches.overall_label: SBC / BF&M 2000 — Council-led + Congregational; three male co-lead pastors; expository preaching; men's ministry confirmed

score_notes.christology: Beliefs page explicitly affirms triune God with 'distinct personal attributes'; Christ as 'fully God, fully man' and 'the eternal Son of God'; exclusivity stated: 'There is no salvation apart from personal faith in Jesus Christ as Lord.' Full Nicene orthodoxy via BF&M 2000.
score_notes.scripture: BF&M 2000 inerrancy adopted verbatim: 'All Scripture is totally true and trustworthy...truth, without any mixture of error.' Authority over creeds and opinions affirmed.
score_notes.gender: BF&M 2000 complementarian framework: 'the office of pastor is limited to men as qualified by Scripture'; marriage 'uniting of one man and one woman'; husband headship / wife submission modeled on Christ-church. Explicit opposition to 'all forms of sexual immorality, including adultery, homosexuality, and pornography.' All three lead pastors and all four lay Church Council members are male.
score_notes.leadership: Self-described as 'Council-Led, Congregational.' Church Council functions as elders/overseers/pastors and includes three male lead pastors + four elected male lay members (Chad White, Dave Velloney, Jeff Benson, Rusty Bailey). Plural-elder model with congregational accountability on budgets, officer elections, constitutional amendments, and pastoral staff calls. Strong polity.
score_notes.soteriology: BF&M 2000 sola fide: 'Salvation involves the redemption of the whole man, and is offered freely to all who accept Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour'; baptism explicitly symbolic, not salvific (Section VII). Regeneration / justification / sanctification / glorification model articulated.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT framing found on Our Beliefs, leadership, or homepage. Traditional sexual ethics maintained throughout. Vision statement is Christocentric: 'Living every day captivated and changed by Jesus.'
score_notes.preaching: Sermon archive evidences expository book-by-book preaching — current series include 'Unfinished Work: Titus' and 'The Last Week' (Mark). All three lead pastors rotate as primary preachers.
score_notes.mission: Four-pillar strategy: Worship, Connect, Serve, Go (missions & outreach). Executive Director of Missions and Outreach is a senior staff role. Great Commission framing throughout.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Dedicated Men's Ministry page in primary navigation. Programs include Men's Groups (via Church Center) and 'ManCake' men's breakfast. Stated emphasis on 'the biblical leadership role of men in the home and in the Body of Christ' with Proverbs 27:17 iron-sharpens-iron framing.
score_notes.denominational: Southern Baptist Convention via explicit BF&M 2000 adoption. Planted out of South Norfolk Baptist Church (purchased the 11.5-acre Great Bridge Blvd property in 1998 and sent the church plant). SBC accountability + Baptist heritage.

churches.assessment: River Oak Church is a strong SBC option for Hampton Roads-area men. The church plants out of South Norfolk Baptist Church (1998 land purchase, 1999 first service at Oscar F. Smith High School, 2000 formal constitution, 2007 facility opening on Great Bridge Blvd), and adopts the Baptist Faith and Message 2000 verbatim. The doctrinal statement hits every conservative-evangelical mark: triune God, full deity and exclusivity of Christ, inerrant Scripture as 'totally true and trustworthy...without any mixture of error,' salvation by grace through faith alone, believer's baptism by immersion, complementarian marriage and pastoral office ('the office of pastor is limited to men'), and explicit opposition to homosexuality and sexual immorality. Governance is 'Council-Led, Congregational' — a hybrid plural-elder + congregational-vote model where the three Co-Lead Pastors (Hammen, Waldrop, LaRussa, all called 2024) plus four elected male lay councilors function as elders/overseers/pastors and the congregation votes on budgets, officer elections, constitutional amendments, and pastoral calls. Preaching is expository (current series through Titus and Mark). Dedicated Men's Ministry with Men's Groups and the ManCake breakfast confirms intentional men's discipleship. No DEI/CRT or affirming language found on the public pages. Green across all ten dimensions.
